citation: Wong, Anita Mei-Yin, Candice Chi-Hang Cheung, Joanna Man-Wai Lo, and Elaine Kit-Hung Wan. 2022. Grammatical Analysis of Cantonese Samples. In Understanding Development and Disorders in Cantonese Using Language Sample Analysis. Routledge.
locator: Section 2.1 Manner adverbs, lines corresponding to examples 佢好大力咁踢我, 佢偷偷地走咗, and 慢慢行，唔好跑呀
verified_claim: Defines manner adverbs as VP modifiers and distinguishes adjective + gam2, reduplicated adjective or verb + dei2, and bare manner-adverb examples. Directly attests hou2 daai6lik6 gam2 + VP, tau1tau1-dei2 + VP, and maan6-maan2 + VP.
limitation: The clinical grammar framework groups functional types for analysis; it does not prove unrestricted lexical productivity or make the three surface strategies one construction.

citation: Wong, Anita Mei-Yin. 2022. A Grammatical Overview of Cantonese. In Understanding Development and Disorders in Cantonese Using Language Sample Analysis. Routledge.
locator: Adverbial modifiers; examples 你乖乖地食飯先 and 你細細聲咁講俾我聽啦
verified_claim: Separates postverbal dak1 + adjective, preverbal adjective reduplication with or without dei2, and adjective + gam2 + verb; exact examples show reduplicated material with dei2 and a reduplicated noun-like manner phrase before gam2.
limitation: Overview-level description does not settle all semantic differences, the complete reduplicable lexicon, or whether every intersection deserves a separate construction identity.

citation: Chan, Ho Leung. 2008. Reduplication with Phonological Fixed Segmentism—The Emergence of the Unmarked Tone in Cantonese. Proceedings of LingO 2007, 43–50.

verified_claim: Analyzes AA + dei2 as a productive attenuative construction and documents optional or speaker-conditioned high-rising tone on the second copy, including maan6maan2dei2.
limitation: This is primarily a property or attenuative reduplication analysis; it does not make every AA + VP sequence a manner adverb or equate dei2 with gam2.

citation: Lee, Jackson L. 2012. Fixed-tone reduplication in Cantonese. McGill Working Papers in Linguistics 22(1).
locator: Abstract and sections on A-A-dei2, A-A-dei2-B, tonal alternation, speaker groups, and corpus scarcity
verified_claim: Shows that AA-dei2 and related forms involve reduplication, affixation, and tonal alternation; reports speaker variation and warns that corpus evidence is sparse.
limitation: The phonological analysis does not define a general preverbal manner construction and cannot license surface-string equality as a sufficient parser condition.

citation: Yip, Virginia, and Stephen Matthews. 2017. Intermediate Cantonese: A Grammar and Workbook. 2nd ed. Routledge.
locator: Unit 4 Reduplication; sections on changed tone, AABB adjectives and adverbs, and exercises with adverbial uses
profile: Broader reduplicated adjective and adverb inventory
verified_claim: Documents multiple Cantonese reduplication patterns, changed tone, bare AABB adverbial uses such as casual or quick manner, and explicitly warns that productive coinage can be hit or miss because the processes are not entirely predictable.
limitation: Pedagogical examples establish conventional patterns and boundaries, not an exhaustive lexical inventory or one uniform AA schema.

citation: Barrie, Michael. 2009. The Syntax and Semantics of Adverb Placement in Cantonese. MOSS conference presentation.

limitation: Conference-handout judgements and one analysis require corroboration; the source does not establish every lexical host or resolve all subject-oriented readings.
